recentItems.title: Fake news, cyberattacks and the real UK warship Black Sea standoff
recentItems.description:
In June 2021, an incident involving a Royal Navy warship saw both the UK and Russia battle for control of the narrative.

And that clash has now been turned into a board game, training the next generation to win the story, not just the fight.

The game, which is called Defending Defender, was inspired by the real-life experience of HMS Defender in the Crimean Strait in 2021.
